description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.

latest_release.name: LoopForge v0.3.8
latest_release.body:
## Install

```bash
git clone --branch v0.3.8 https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge.git
cd LoopForge
./start.sh
```

Platform image: `ghcr.io/tencent/loopforge:0.3.8` (pinned in `compose.yaml`).

Digest: `ghcr.io/tencent/loopforge@sha256:481ecb6334a21308acb93f164f5dc74f508109d3e108089981a7ea87de095963`.

Where `ghcr.io` is slow, set `MIRROR` to a registry host that replaces it (for example `MIRROR=ghcr.nju.edu.cn ./start.sh`). This trusts that host: the download is tagged as the pinned name. Check it with `docker image inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' ghcr.io/tencent/loopforge:0.3.8` and compare the digest after `@`. Existing installations: check out `v0.3.8`, run `./start.sh`, and apply the new files under `migrations/` listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/blob/v0.3.8/CHANGELOG.md).

## What's Changed
* fix(deps): patch vulnerable chatbot test toolchain by @hxy91819 in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/166
* ci: mirror the platform image to TCR after publishing GHCR by @cocofhu in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/205
* fix(runtime): keep index.lock while an alternate-path holder is live by @Robert0622 in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/133
* ci(platform): run repository-bound and second-user e2e API tests by @Robert0622 in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/140
* fix(chatbot): clear the missing-key notice once quick access saves a key by @Robert0622 in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/184
* fix(access): never emit http:// endpoints for token-bearing snippets on https by @Robert0622 in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/132
* fix(auth): do not trust identity headers from forwarded clients by @Robert0622 in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/136
* fix(runtime): clip tool messages and executor output on rune boundaries by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/191
* feat: render sandbox dev servers natively in the side browser by @crispinhu27 in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/162
* feat(web): show the image commit in the corner by @cocofhu in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/206
* fix(web): restore the AI orchestrator build animations by @Robert0622 in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/135
* docs: pull the platform image through the NJU GHCR cache by @cocofhu in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/213
* feat: ask before handing a requirement to an SOP by @crispinhu27 in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/157
* chore(release): prepare v0.3.8 by @Robert0622 in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/216

## New Contributors
* @hxy91819 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/166
* @kevin9327 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/pull/191

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge/compare/v0.3.7...v0.3.8

detail.readme:
English · 简体中文

Two ways to work · Quick start · SOPs · Features · Local · FAQ · Docs

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8af401d9-1aae-427c-b4bc-455c12d17beb

80-second product tour (1080p, with sound).

**LoopForge** is a self-hosted workspace where your team ships software with coding agents. Describe what you need to **Main Bot** in chat: it opens a Docker sandbox, checks out your repositories, delegates to project roles, and opens the PR. When a way of working proves itself, save it as an **SOP** (a standard workflow of agents, scripts and human gates) so the next requirement is delivered the same way, with review and approval built in. Coding-agent CLIs do the work: CodeBuddy, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Antigravity, Kimi Code, Pi, DeepSeek Harness and ZCode. LoopForge adds the roles, sandboxes, checkpoints and history around them, all on your own infrastructure under the MIT license. ## Two ways to work | | **Chat with Main Bot** | **Run an SOP** | | --- | --- | --- | | Best for | Exploring, quick fixes, iterating with the agent | Repeatable delivery with fixed stages and sign-off | | How it runs | Main Bot opens a [conversation workspace](docs/conversation-workspaces.md) (a Docker sandbox with your repos) on demand and calls project roles as subagents | The engine runs Agent, Script, Human-gate and sub-SOP nodes in order, in their own sandbox | | You stay in control by | Queuing or steering messages mid-reply, and pausing, resuming or taking over a running SOP from chat | Approving at human gates, sending work back to a chosen step, retrying or rerunning from any node | | Delivers | A PR/MR, or a direct merge into a shared branch (`mode=direct`) | Documents, code or a PR, plus per-node artifacts and logs | Both paths track the same **requirements**, so every change, whether made in chat or by an SOP, links back to what was asked for and counts toward delivery and cost reports.

The chat home. Type a request, @ a role, skill, requirement, SOP or repository, and pick the executor, model and permission mode per conversation.

## Why LoopForge Ask a coding agent to "fix this bug" and the result depends on that run. It might skip the plan, forget the tests, review its own code, or stop halfway without anyone noticing. That's fine for a demo, but it isn't how a team ships. - **Repeatable.** Same SOP, same stages, same checks for every requirement. Start from built-in backend, frontend, bug-fix and product SOPs. - **Separated roles.** Planning, implementation, review and testing each get their own prompt, executor, model, rules, Skills and MCP tools. A role works as an SOP node or as a subagent in chat. - **Human in the loop.** Approval gates where they matter. Read the report, approve, or send the work back to a chosen step. - **Observable and resumable.** Node status, tool traces, logs and artifacts in one place. Pause, retry a failed step, or rerun from any node. - **Your stack, your servers.** Ten coding-agent CLIs as executors, from CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code to OpenCode, Cursor CLI and more. GitHub, Skills and MCP as tools. Docker sandboxes or your own machine as the runtime. ## Quick start Install **Git** and clone the repository first. The installer checks Docker, Compose, Python 3 and curl and offers to install missing components. Python/curl installation supports apt, dnf and yum on Linux; the Compose plugin supports x86_64/arm64 and verifies the official release SHA-256. macOS needs a working Python 3 and Docker Desktop; Homebrew can install missing components. Ordinary Linux users are supported through Docker group access or sudo. Set `LOOPFORGE_YES=1` to accept installation prompts. Package and image downloads require internet access. ```bash git clone https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge.git cd LoopForge ./start.sh ``` `./start.sh` pulls the GHCR release image pinned in `compose.yaml` without building locally (`bash scripts/install.sh` does the same). It creates the MySQL and platform services, generates configuration and session secrets, and installs the built-in sandboxes, starter SOPs and welcome project. Host Go and Node.js installations are not required. Configure model API keys and GitHub authorization after startup. Use `./start.sh logs`, `stop`, `restart` or `pull` to manage it, and `./start.sh dev` to build the checkout from source. If downloads from `ghcr.io` stall, set `MIRROR` to a registry host that can stand in for `ghcr.io`. `./start.sh` pulls from that host and tags the image back to the name pinned in `compose.yaml`. Setting `MIRROR` trusts that host, because the download is tagged with the official name. The GitHub Release records the digest; `docker image inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' ghcr.io/tencent/loopforge:` should show the same digest after `@`. Without `MIRROR`, `./start.sh` still pulls `ghcr.io` directly, and `compose.yaml` stays unchanged. Upgrade with the same variable and `./start.sh pull`. [ghcr.nju.edu.cn](https://doc.nju.edu.cn/books/e1654/page/ghcr) is one such host. A Docker `registry-mirrors` entry such as `https://docker.nju.edu.cn` only accelerates Docker Hub and is not a value for `MIRROR`. ```bash MIRROR=ghcr.nju.edu.cn ./start.sh ``` Open the address printed by the installer and create your account; the first one becomes the administrator. The service listens on `0.0.0.0:8090` by default. On a cloud host, the installer reads the public IP from the provider's metadata service and prints it; allow the port in your security group, or put an HTTPS reverse proxy in front. Restrict access to your own IP until the administrator account exists. The home page's quick-access guide walks you through adding a model key, connecting a repository and choosing an SOP. For GitLab, Gitea, Gogs and other Git hosts, [set up Git SSH](docs/deployment.md#git-repositories-over-ssh) to check out and push branches with a personal key. PR/MR and Issue automation requires a hosting API token or a separately configured MCP. ### Try it without an API key New accounts join the **LoopForge demo project**, which includes an SOP made only of a script and a human gate: 1. Switch to the demo project, open **Templates**, and open **Platform check · script & approval**. 2. Click **Run SOP**. A real script writes a report, then the run waits for you at the approval step. 3. Approve it from **Needs review** or the run page, and watch the run continue to its final artifact. ### What you need for real work | I want to… | You need | | --- | --- | | Run the script + approval demo | Nothing | | Chat with Main Bot, generate a document or a new project | An API key for the selected executor | | Change an existing repository (in chat or via an SOP) and open a PR | Model credentials and a GitHub repository (connect GitHub in personal settings) |
More setup details: executors, GitHub, sandboxes, access model
- **Executors.** Pick one of ten CLIs beside the home composer, then a model. Every SOP role can choose its executor independently (built-in roles default to CodeBuddy). Requirement clarification, AI notification summaries, Bot replies and run evals currently use CodeBuddy, so their model pickers list CodeBuddy models only and the server refuses a model of another CLI instead of switching it to CodeBuddy; scheduled assistant tasks run on the CLI the task selects. | Executor | Credentials | Installation | | --- | --- | --- | | **CodeBuddy** | Personal key, or a shared key an administrator configures for chat and SOP runs | In the Docker image | | **Codex** | Personal key; a connected execution machine can use its local login | In the Docker image | | **Claude Code** | Personal key; a connected execution machine can use its local login | Installed from npm on first use, then cached | | **OpenCode · Kimi Code · Pi** | Personal key only | Installed from npm on first use, then cached | | **DeepSeek Harness** | Personal key only | In the Docker image | | **Cursor CLI · Antigravity** | Personal key only | Provider installer on first chat use; not installed into SOP sandboxes | | **ZCode** | Personal key only | Not bundled; install it on the service or execution machine PATH | The seven agent CLIs after Claude Code keep their model and MCP configuration in a private home directory per run, so they always use the responsible user's own key and Base URL from personal settings, even on a connected execution machine. When rolling them out to a team, each member configures their own credentials. First-use installs need npm or provider access; [native deployments](docs/deployment.md#workers-and-runners) need the CLI for the executor you choose. - **GitHub is optional.** All built-in generic SOPs run without a repository: product SOPs deliver documents, and new frontend/backend projects deliver source files in the task workspace. Bug fixes still need source code and reproduction details. Connect a repository when you work on existing code or want PRs. - **Delivering to a repository.** Choose **Connect GitHub** in personal settings, approve the device code on GitHub and pick your repository (the LoopForge OAuth App is built in; no PAT required, manual PAT entry still works). Set executor credentials (or bind a local execution machine), then either run a project SOP or ask Main Bot to change the code and submit a PR/MR. - **Sandboxes.** In the default Compose installation, SOP runs and conversation workspaces both use Docker sandbox containers started through the host Docker socket. Default sandboxes reuse the installed runtime image, so nothing extra is built after installation; custom Dockerfiles still build their own images. Docker socket access grants control of the host daemon, so this setup is for trusted teams, not untrusted multi-tenant isolation. See [deployment boundaries](docs/deployment.md#accounts). Re-running the installer keeps your data. - **Accounts and access.** New installations listen on all interfaces (existing bind settings are kept) and are designed for a trusted team: signed-in users can read project data across the instance, and teammates can sign up from the login page (`AGENTFLOW_ALLOW_SIGNUP=false` in `.env` turns that off). Read the [account and access model](docs/deployment.md#accounts) before exposing it beyond your team. - **Remote access, HTTPS, separate workers.** See [Deployment](docs/deployment.md). - **Hacking on LoopForge itself?** `bash scripts/dev.sh` runs it natively (Go 1.26.11+).
## How SOPs work An **SOP** is the workflow a delivery follows. Agents, scripts and people take part in the same run:

The SOP designer with the built-in bug-fix SOP. Each step picks a role; failed checks can send the work back to an earlier step.

| Node | What it does | | --- | --- | | **Agent** | A role (prompt, executor, model, rules, Skills and MCP tools) that designs, implements, reviews or tests. | | **Script** | A deterministic shell step: build, test, lint, generate a report. No AI where AI is not needed. | | **Human gate** | Pauses the run until someone checks the artifacts and approves, or sends the work back to a step. | | **Sub-SOP** | Runs another SOP as a sub-workflow. | | **Preview build** | Builds a static site and archives it for review. | Each node declares its artifacts and dependencies, and the engine starts each step once its dependencies complete. Start from a built-in SOP, adapt its roles, rules and environment to your project, and publish versions as it evolves.

A run waiting at a human gate: approve and continue, add context and rerun the step, or send the work back upstream.

**A delivery we actually ran:** four CodeBuddy roles planned a Python fix, implemented it, reviewed it independently and summarized the delivery. Three real tests passed; the run waited for human approval, then verified the accepted code had not changed. The [reusable acceptance case](e2e/api/45-delivery-model.test.mjs) checks the files and results. See the [validation record](docs/validation.md) for scope and known gaps. ## Features | Area | What you get | | --- | --- | | **Chat workbench** | Main Bot with per-conversation executor, model and permission mode. `@` references for roles, skills, requirements, SOPs and repositories. Messages queue while a reply runs; *Steer* interrupts and sends now. Generated files open in a side panel with preview, source and download. | | **Conversation workspaces** | On-demand Docker sandboxes with the project's repositories checked out, project roles as native subagents, and direct control of a running SOP workspace: pause, resume or take over. | | **SOP designer** | Visual canvas with Agent, Script, Human gate, Sub-SOP and Preview nodes, rework-on-failure edges, validation, version history and publishing. Built-in backend, frontend, bug-fix and product SOPs. | | **Roles** | Reusable definitions: prompt, executor, model, rules, Skills, MCP tools, artifacts and gates, shared across SOP nodes and chat subagents. | | **Requirement → delivery** | Requirements tracked end to end, whether shipped by an SOP or straight from chat, with PR/MR status tracking, merge detection and direct-branch merges. | | **Runs & approvals** | Live node status, tool traces, worker logs, per-node artifact snapshots and workspace previews. A single **Needs review** inbox for every gate waiting on you. | | **AI scheduled tasks** | Recurring agent tasks with full workspace, SOP and MCP access; a shared market of versioned, parameterized task templates; automatic SOP dispatch for new requirements. | | **Insights & cost** | Engineering metrics, business-domain reports with static HTML/SVG export, and token/cost accounting for SOPs and conversations at public list prices. | | **Execution environments** | Platform workers, Docker sandboxes, or a connected local execution machine using your own tools and repositories. | | **Team-ready** | Password accounts, projects and members, light/dark/system themes, an OpenAPI-described HTTP and MCP API. Management pages are in English and Chinese; the chat workbench is Chinese for now. |

Built-in SOPs are read-only blueprints; copy one into your project to run and edit it.

## LoopForge Local Don't want to run a server? **LoopForge Local** brings the built-in delivery workflows straight into the coding assistant you already use: ```bash # Run inside your target project, e.g. for Claude Code npx -y loopforge-cli@latest install claude ``` Then run `/start-devflow ""` in Claude Code. | Host | Supported | | --- | --- | | Claude Code · CodeBuddy · Codex · Cursor | Classic (default) and Portable editions | | Pi | Portable edition | | DeepSeek Harness | Portable edition | | Hermes Agent | Portable edition | See the [local guide](docs/local/usage.md) for each host's entry point and [editions](docs/local/editions.md) for the differences. Source lives in [`local/`](local/). Local runs the built-in workflows today; exporting a platform SOP for standalone local execution is planned. | | Platform | Local | | --- | --- | --- | | Best for | Teams sharing chat workspaces, SOPs, approvals and history | One developer inside an IDE or CLI | | Needs | Docker + Python 3 | Node.js 20+, Python 3.8+ and a coding assistant | | Workflows | Chat with Main Bot + custom SOPs on a visual canvas | Built-in Classic / Portable workflows | | Evidence | Shared run details, approvals and metrics in the web workspace | Artifacts under `artifacts/{task_slug}/` + optional local dashboard | ## FAQ **Do I need an API key to try it?** No. The demo SOP uses only a script and a human gate. Chat and agent steps need a key for the executor you pick. Model usage is not included; you bring your own credentials. **Do I need GitHub?** No. Chat, documents and new projects run in the task workspace. Connect GitHub when you want to change an existing repository or open PRs. **Should I use chat or an SOP?** Use chat to explore and iterate; Main Bot can still open a PR. Once you find a way of working you want every requirement to follow, with fixed reviewers, tests and sign-off, put it in an SOP. Main Bot can start, pause and take over SOP runs, so the two paths work together. **How is this different from Dify, n8n or Flowise?** Those are general-purpose AI and automation workflow builders. LoopForge is built for **software delivery with coding agents**: implementer and reviewer roles, Docker sandboxes with real repositories, GitHub delivery, human acceptance gates and run evidence. **How is this different from using Claude Code, Codex, CodeBuddy or another coding CLI directly?** LoopForge doesn't replace them; it orchestrates them. Each agent step and each chat turn runs one of those CLIs. LoopForge adds what surrounds it: who does what, in which sandbox, in which order, with which checks, and who signs off. **Is it safe to expose on the internet?** New installations listen on all interfaces and target a trusted team. Read the [account and access model](docs/deployment.md#accounts) and set up HTTPS before opening it up. Report vulnerabilities privately via the [security policy](SECURITY.md). ## Documentation | I want to… | Start here | | --- | --- | | Deploy, manage accounts, connect execution machines | [Deployment](docs/deployment.md) | | Understand chat workspaces, scheduled AI tasks and token pricing | [Conversation workspaces](docs/conversation-workspaces.md) · [AI scheduled tasks](docs/ai-scheduled-task-capabilities.md) · [Token pricing](docs/token-pricing.md) | | Install local workflows or choose an edition | [LoopForge Local](docs/local/usage.md) · [Editions](docs/local/editions.md) | | Extend the platform or use the HTTP / MCP API | [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) · [API reference](docs/api/README.md) · [Shared schedules API](docs/api/shared-schedules.md) | | Contribute to the UI | [Frontend design conventions](design.md) (Chinese) | | Check functional coverage and release readiness | [Validation record](docs/validation.md) · [Acceptance matrix](docs/testing/acceptance-matrix.md) · [Release review](docs/release-readiness.md) | | Understand source provenance and maintenance | [Public scope](docs/open-source-scope.md) · [Upstream synchronization](docs/upstream-sync.md) | ## Community Scan the QR code to join the LoopForge community group. ## Contributing Issues and PRs are welcome: share a use case, report a bug, or improve workflows, integrations and the platform experience. Start with the [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md). Security issues go through the [security policy](SECURITY.md). If LoopForge is useful to you, a star helps others find it. ## License [MIT](LICENSE). Third-party components keep their own licenses and notices; see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
detail.readme_zh:
English · 简体中文

两种工作方式 · 快速开始 · SOP · 功能 · 本地版 · FAQ · 文档

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/10b8ae2e-d7e7-4b78-8876-c45818d4a08f

80 秒产品演示（1080p，有声）。

**LoopForge** 是一个可自主部署的团队工作台，让你和编程 Agent 一起交付软件。在对话里把需求告诉 **Main Bot**：它会按需打开 Docker 沙箱、检出项目仓库、把任务分派给项目角色，最后提交 PR。某种做法被验证有效后，把它存成 **SOP**（由 Agent、脚本和人工关口组成的标准交付流程），下一个需求就按同样的方式交付，评审和验收都在流程里。 干活的是编程 Agent CLI：CodeBuddy、Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Cursor CLI、Antigravity、Kimi Code、Pi、DeepSeek Harness 和 ZCode；LoopForge 负责它们外面的角色、沙箱、检查点和留痕，全部运行在你自己的环境里，MIT 开源。 ## 两种工作方式 | | **与 Main Bot 对话** | **运行 SOP** | | --- | --- | --- | | 适合 | 探索、快速修复、与 Agent 反复迭代 | 阶段固定、需要签字确认的可重复交付 | | 如何运行 | Main Bot 按需打开[对话工作区](docs/conversation-workspaces.md)（带项目仓库的 Docker 沙箱），并把项目角色作为子 Agent 调用 | 引擎按顺序执行 Agent、脚本、人工关口和子 SOP 节点，每次运行有独立沙箱 | | 你如何把控 | 回复中途排队或「引导」消息；在对话里暂停、恢复或接管正在运行的 SOP | 在人工关口审批；打回到指定环节返工；从任意节点重试或重跑 | | 交付物 | PR/MR，或直推合入共享分支（`mode=direct`） | 文档、代码或 PR，以及每个节点的产物和日志 | 两种方式都挂在同一套**需求**上：无论改动来自对话还是 SOP，都能追溯到原始需求，并计入交付与成本统计。

对话首页：描述需求，用 @ 引用角色、技能、需求、SOP 或仓库；每个会话可单独选择执行器、模型和确认模式。

## 为什么需要 LoopForge 让编程 Agent "修一下这个 Bug"，结果往往取决于这一次的运行：可能跳过方案，可能忘了跑测试，可能自己评审自己的代码，也可能做到一半停下而没人发现。做演示没问题，但团队交付不能这样。 - **可重复。** 同一条 SOP、同样的阶段、同样的检查，每个需求都一样。内置后端、前端、缺陷修复、产品方案四类 SOP 可直接起步。 - **角色分离。** 方案、实现、评审、测试各有独立的角色提示词、执行器、模型、规则、Skills 和 MCP 工具；同一个角色既能做 SOP 节点，也能在对话中作为子 Agent 调用。 - **人在回路。** 在关键节点设置人工审批：看完报告再放行，或打回到指定环节返工。 - **可观测、可续跑。** 节点状态、工具轨迹、日志和产物集中呈现；支持暂停、重试失败步骤、从任意节点重跑。 - **技术栈和服务器都是你的。** 执行器支持 10 种编程 Agent CLI，从 CodeBuddy、Codex、Claude Code 到 OpenCode、Cursor CLI 等；工具接入 GitHub、Skills、MCP；运行环境可选 Docker 沙箱或你自己的机器。 ## 快速开始 先准备 **Git** 并克隆仓库。安装脚本会检查 Docker、Compose、Python 3 和 curl，并在获得确认后补装缺少的组件：Linux 的 Python/curl 支持 apt、dnf、yum，Compose 插件支持 x86_64/arm64 并校验官方发行文件的 SHA-256；macOS 需要可运行的 Python 3 和 Docker Desktop，可通过 Homebrew 补装缺少的组件。支持普通用户运行，需要时通过 Docker 组或 sudo 操作 Docker。设置 `LOOPFORGE_YES=1` 可接受安装提示；安装和拉取镜像需要可用的外网连接。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/Tencent/LoopForge.git cd LoopForge ./start.sh ``` `./start.sh` 直接拉取 `compose.yaml` 中 pin 的 GHCR 发布镜像，不在本地构建（`bash scripts/install.sh` 效果相同）。安装流程会创建 MySQL 和平台服务，生成配置与会话密钥，并导入内置沙箱、通用 SOP 和体验项目；无需在宿主机安装 Go 或 Node.js。模型 API Key 和 GitHub 授权在启动后由用户配置。用 `./start.sh logs`、`stop`、`restart`、`pull` 管理服务；需要从源码构建时用 `./start.sh dev`。 国内拉取 `ghcr.io` 经常中断。把 `MIRROR` 设成可以替换 `ghcr.io` 的镜像站主机名，`./start.sh` 会用它拉取，再改回 `compose.yaml` 里的原名。设置 `MIRROR` 表示信任该主机，因为下载结果会被标成官方镜像名。发布说明里有 digest，可用 `docker image inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' ghcr.io/tencent/loopforge:` 核对，`@` 后面的摘要应一致。不设置时仍直接从 `ghcr.io` 拉取。`compose.yaml` 不用改。升级时带上同一个变量执行 `./start.sh pull`。南京大学的 GHCR 镜像站是 [ghcr.nju.edu.cn](https://doc.nju.edu.cn/books/e1654/page/ghcr)。Docker 引擎里的 `registry-mirrors`（包括 `https://docker.nju.edu.cn`）只加速 Docker Hub，不能填在这里。 ```bash MIRROR=ghcr.nju.edu.cn ./start.sh ``` 打开安装脚本输出的地址创建账号，第一个账号自动成为管理员。服务默认监听 `0.0.0.0:8090`；在云主机上，安装脚本会从云厂商的元数据服务读取公网 IP 并直接打印出来，放通安全组端口即可访问，或配置 HTTPS 反向代理；管理员账号创建前，建议只允许你的 IP 访问。首页的「快速接入」会带你配置模型凭据、绑定仓库并选好默认 SOP。 GitLab、Gitea、Gogs 等托管可[配置 Git SSH](docs/deployment.md#git-repositories-over-ssh)，用个人密钥检出和推送分支。Issue 与 PR/MR 自动化需要托管平台的 API Token 或另行配置的 MCP。[CNB 官方仅支持 HTTPS + 访问令牌](https://docs.cnb.cool/zh/guide/git-access.html)。 ### 免 API Key 体验 新注册的账号会自动加入 **LoopForge 体验项目**，其中有一条只包含脚本和人工审批的 SOP： 1. 切换到体验项目，打开 **流程模板**，进入 **平台验收 · 脚本与审批**。 2. 点击 **运行流程**。真实脚本会生成一份报告，然后在审批节点等你确认。 3. 在 **待我确认** 或运行详情页审批通过，观察流程继续执行并产出最终产物。 ### 真实任务需要准备什么 | 我想要… | 需要准备 | | --- | --- | | 跑通脚本 + 人工审批体验 | 什么都不需要 | | 与 Main Bot 对话、生成文档或新项目 | 所选执行器的 API Key | | 修改已有仓库（通过对话或 SOP）并提交 PR | 模型凭据 + GitHub 仓库（在个人设置中连接 GitHub） |
更多配置说明：执行器、GitHub、沙箱、访问模型
- **执行器。** 在首页输入框旁从 10 种 CLI 中选择一种，再选择模型。每个 SOP 角色都可以独立选择执行器（内置角色默认 CodeBuddy）。需求澄清、通知 AI 汇总、Bot 回复和运行评测目前使用 CodeBuddy，这些入口的模型列表只列 CodeBuddy 模型，服务端收到其他 CLI 的模型会直接拒绝并说明原因，不会悄悄换成 CodeBuddy；定时助手任务使用任务所选的执行器。 | 执行器 | 凭据 | 安装方式 | | --- | --- | --- | | **CodeBuddy** | 个人 Key，或管理员配置的平台共享 Key（覆盖对话和 SOP 运行） | Docker 镜像内置 | | **Codex** | 个人 Key；已连接的执行机器可使用本机登录 | Docker 镜像内置 | | **Claude Code** | 个人 Key；已连接的执行机器可使用本机登录 | 首次使用时从 npm 安装并缓存 | | **OpenCode · Kimi Code · Pi** | 仅个人 Key | 首次使用时从 npm 安装并缓存 | | **DeepSeek Harness** | 仅个人 Key | Docker 镜像内置 | | **Cursor CLI · Antigravity** | 仅个人 Key | 首次在对话中使用时通过厂商安装脚本安装；不会装进 SOP 沙箱 | | **ZCode** | 仅个人 Key | 未内置，需安装到服务或执行机器的 PATH 中 | Claude Code 之后的 7 种 Agent CLI 每次运行都在私有 HOME 目录里生成模型和 MCP 配置，因此始终使用需求责任人在个人设置中填写的 Key 和 Base URL，即使在已连接的执行机器上也一样。团队推广时，每位成员需要各自配置凭据。首次安装需要能访问 npm 或对应厂商；[原生部署](docs/deployment.md#workers-and-runners)需安装所选执行器的 CLI。 - **GitHub 可选。** 所有内置通用 SOP 都可以不绑定仓库运行：产品方案交付文档，前后端新项目在任务工作区交付源码；缺陷修复仍需提供待修代码和复现材料。需要修改已有代码或提交 PR 时再绑定仓库。 - **交付到仓库。** 在个人设置中点击「连接 GitHub」，用设备码授权后选择自己的仓库（已内置 LoopForge 授权应用，无需申请 PAT，仍可手动填写 PAT），再配置执行器凭据（或绑定本机执行机器），之后既可以运行一条项目 SOP，也可以直接让 Main Bot 修改代码并提交 PR/MR。 - **沙箱。** 默认 Compose 安装中，SOP 运行和对话工作区都使用 Docker 沙箱容器，由平台通过宿主机 Docker socket 启动；默认沙箱复用已安装的运行镜像，安装后无需再构建；自定义 Dockerfile 仍单独构建。Docker socket 赋予平台控制宿主机 Docker 的权限，因此只适用于可信团队，不构成不可信多租户隔离边界；详见[部署边界](docs/deployment.md#accounts)。重复执行安装脚本会保留已有数据。 - **账号与访问。** 新安装默认监听所有网卡（已有安装保留原配置），面向可信团队：已登录用户可以读取实例内各项目的数据，团队成员可在登录页自助注册（在 `.env` 中设置 `AGENTFLOW_ALLOW_SIGNUP=false` 可关闭）。对团队以外开放前，请先阅读[账号与访问边界](docs/deployment.md#accounts)。 - **远程访问、HTTPS、独立 Worker。** 见[部署指南](docs/deployment.md)。 - **参与 LoopForge 本身的开发？** 用 `bash scripts/dev.sh` 原生运行（需要 Go 1.26.11+）。
## SOP 如何运行 **SOP** 就是每次交付遵循的工作流程。Agent、脚本和人在同一次运行中衔接：

流程设计器中的内置缺陷修复 SOP。每个步骤选择一个角色；检查失败时可以打回到前面的步骤。

| 节点 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | **Agent** | 一个角色（提示词、执行器、模型、规则、Skills、MCP 工具），负责设计、实现、评审或测试。 | | **脚本** | 确定性的 Shell 步骤：构建、测试、Lint、生成报告。不需要 AI 的地方就不用 AI。 | | **人工关口** | 暂停运行，等人检查产物后放行，或打回到指定环节。 | | **子 SOP** | 把另一条 SOP 作为子流程复用。 | | **预览构建** | 构建静态站点并归档，供评审查看。 | 每个节点声明自己的产物和依赖，依赖完成后引擎自动推进下一步。从内置 SOP 起步，按项目调整角色、规则和执行环境，随着流程演进发布新版本。

停在人工关口的运行：确认通过继续下游、补充信息重跑当前节点，或退回上游重做。

**我们实际跑过的一次交付：** 四个 CodeBuddy 角色依次完成 Python 修复的规划、实现、独立评审和交付汇总；三个真实测试通过，运行等待人工批准，批准后再次验证代码与验收时一致。这条链路已沉淀为[可复用验收用例](e2e/api/45-delivery-model.test.mjs)，覆盖范围和未联调项见[实测记录](docs/validation.md)。 ## 功能一览 | 方向 | 能力 | | --- | --- | | **对话工作台** | Main Bot 支持按会话选择执行器、模型和确认模式；`@` 引用角色、技能、需求、SOP 和仓库；回复进行中发送的消息进入排队托盘，「引导」可打断当前回复立即发送；生成的文件在侧边产物抽屉中预览、看源码和下载。 | | **对话工作区** | 按需创建带项目仓库的 Docker 沙箱，把项目角色作为原生子 Agent 调用，并能直接控制正在运行的 SOP 工作区：暂停、恢复或接管。 | | **流程设计器** | 在画布上编排 Agent、脚本、人工关口、子 SOP 和预览构建节点；支持失败打回、配置检查、版本历史与发布。内置后端、前端、缺陷修复和产品方案 SOP。 | | **角色** | 可复用的角色定义：提示词、执行器、模型、规则、Skills、MCP 工具、产物与门禁，SOP 节点和对话子 Agent 共用。 | | **需求到交付** | 无论通过 SOP 还是直接在对话中交付，需求都全程跟踪；支持 PR/MR 状态跟踪、合入检测和共享分支直推。 | | **运行与审批** | 实时节点状态、工具轨迹、Worker 日志、节点产物快照和工作区预览；所有等你处理的关口集中在 **待我确认**。 | | **AI 定时任务** | 周期性 Agent 任务，具备完整的工作区、SOP 与 MCP 权限；共享任务市场提供带版本和参数的任务模板；新需求可自动派发 SOP。 | | **统计与成本** | 研发效能指标、业务领域报表（可导出静态 HTML/SVG），以及按公开标准价核算的 SOP 与对话 Token 成本。 | | **执行环境** | 平台 Worker、Docker 沙箱，或连接一台使用你自己工具和仓库的本地执行机器。 | | **团队协作** | 密码账号、项目与成员、浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统主题，以及有 OpenAPI 描述的 HTTP 与 MCP API。管理页面支持中英文，对话工作台目前为中文界面。 |

内置 SOP 是平台维护的只读蓝图，复制到本项目后即可运行和修改。

常见问题 **体验需要 API Key 吗？** 不需要。体验 SOP 只包含脚本和人工审批。对话和 Agent 步骤需要所选执行器的 Key。平台不附带模型额度，凭据由你自己配置。 **必须接入 GitHub 吗？** 不必。对话、文档和新项目都在任务工作区完成。需要修改已有仓库或提交 PR 时再接入 GitHub。 **什么时候用对话，什么时候用 SOP？** 探索和迭代用对话，Main Bot 同样可以提交 PR。当你希望每个需求都按同一套做法交付，有固定的评审、测试和签字环节，就把它做成 SOP。Main Bot 可以启动、暂停和接管 SOP 运行，两种方式可以配合使用。 **和 Dify、n8n、Flowise 有什么区别？** 它们是通用的 AI / 自动化工作流搭建平台。LoopForge 专注于 **用编程 Agent 做软件交付**：实现者与评审者等角色分工、带真实仓库的 Docker 沙箱、GitHub 交付、人工验收关口和运行证据。 **和直接用 Claude Code / Codex / CodeBuddy 等编程 CLI 有什么区别？** LoopForge 不替代它们，而是编排它们。每个 Agent 步骤和每轮对话都运行这些 CLI 之一；LoopForge 补上外面的部分：谁来做、在哪个沙箱里、按什么顺序、经过哪些检查、由谁签字。 **可以直接暴露到公网吗？** 新安装默认监听所有网卡，面向可信团队。开放前请阅读[账号与访问边界](docs/deployment.md#accounts)并配置 HTTPS。安全漏洞请按[安全政策](SECURITY.zh-CN.md)私密报告。 ##
